description: Configure when tlly sends stale-data alert email and webhooks because a series stopped updating. after: auto (from the job schedule and point spacing, at least two days), off, hours, or a window like 48h or 7d. Use dashboard_id for every series on a dashboard, series for one series, or both for one series on one dashboard. One email and one webhook when it goes quiet; another when a newer point arrives. Counts toward the hourly caps.

after.description: auto, off, 48h, 7d, or a number of hours

name: set_stale_alert
title: Configure stale-data alerts
